budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-XG3 (LEAD3-S81 10-19): x streamer as its own hard leaf (sibling of ot_s81sl_rs in the slice parent; replaces the s81sl_xg tile whose gates xgr / xgr2 failed: 38k flops one root, 4,486-load index net, 585 / 299 reset fanouts, 27 macro channels < 20 um). RD2=2 = RD2=1 (bank-local 8:1 + 3:1 read stages) + arrival-table and block-exponent lookups through ot_s81sl_xs_lut (kept per-16-entry-group copies of the index low bits + a kept group-select copy: no index flop drives a whole table) + 11 reset regions (kept select copies get their own) + xs_ctl 3rd reset region (p1 / bt pipeline); fault glue fo = reg(fi | fault) moved in from ot_s81sl_xg (same edge). Same edges as xgr's RD2=1 (xg_bench). Floorplan: no abutted macros -- 3 banks x (2 columns x 4 rows), 34.8 um column / 23.7 um row channels, ROM row along S with 70 um gaps, 45 um to the SRAMs; std band N (gather pin flops) + middle (controller, lx) + S (frame-word flops). SAFE checklist: 1 pins waived-with-reason (source-registered), reset_landing ON; 2 reach PASS (864 um wide, every path flop -> <= ~450 um -> flop with the gd_q flops free to sit between face and bank); 3 fanout fixed (lut copies, kept select copies, reset regions); 4 depth PASS (two-stage read crossbar); 5 storage: x buffer SRAM, exponent table 384 x 10 b flops read through kept copies (waived: 3.8 kb with 3 write ports per beat; SRAM move = next variant if it shows); 6 floorplan PASS (channels >= 20, lattice, aspect 1.8); 7 clock km K=16, spread TT+FF <= 80, io_hold_margin 0.03; 8 schedule unchanged vs xgr.
